confidence: Low. Motives are widespread; Chip retains the strongest physical connection, while the others have stronger stated pressures or covert action. None has a demonstrated poisoning opportunity yet.
plausibility_notes: The disputes are individually understandable, but all thirty confessing a lapse followed by donor coercion feels highly uniform and less like spontaneous testimony.
Grant exerting financial control fits the gala; personally blackmailing nearly everyone stretches the villain beyond an ordinary difficult donor.
Artie already having another job materially changes how I read his threatened resignation.
Dada owning the warning usefully gives a threatening clue an ordinary explanation; it should not remain attributed to restitution activists.
